name: StoriesOnBoard
description_en:
StoriesOnBoard is a product in the Task management category. Its directory profile covers Time Tracking, Task Tracking, Task Scheduling, Task Assigning, Reporting (Analytics), Progress Tracking, Gantt Charts, Alerts.

Additional listed capabilities include Collaboration Tools. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $16.0. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: record time spent on selected work; summarize records and activity in reports and metrics; show task timing and dependencies on a timeline; notify users when defined conditions are met; support shared work and communication between participants. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
StoriesOnBoard 属于任务管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括工时跟踪、任务跟踪、任务排程、任务分配、报表与分析、进度跟踪、甘特图、警报提醒。

资料还列出协作工具。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 个人用户。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $16.0. 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：记录在指定工作上花费的时间；将业务记录和活动汇总为报表与指标；在时间轴上展示任务安排及依赖关系；在满足预设条件时通知用户；支持多人共同工作和沟通。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
